title: The Halosar Trap
author: LlamaChess Repertoire
description: Very overpowered trap — the Halosar Gambit (1.d4 d5 2.e4 dxe4 3.Nc3). Sacrifice pawns for a crushing attack on f7.

lessons.title: Main Line — f3 and g4 Attack
lessons.subtitle: Line #1 · Halosar core

steps.title: Main Line — f3 and g4 Attack
steps.theory: Push f3, then g4 and h4. Black's king won't survive the onslaught.
